K6.relation: Brockhaus and Long (2000), second-order Taylor expansion of sqrt around E[V]: K_vol = sqrt(E[V]) - Var(V)/(8 E[V]^{3/2}). With V lognormal, Var(V)/E[V]^2 = exp(s^2)-1, so the adjustment is sqrt(E[V]) * (exp(s^2)-1)/8 with s^2 = Var(log IV).
K6.direction: Naive s^2 exceeds c in every cell, so the naive convexity adjustment is too large and the implied volatility-swap strike too low. That favours the payer of fixed on a volatility swap, i.e. the side that is long volatility at the quoted strike.
K6.no_pnl_claim: No options data is held. This is a pricing-bias calculation on the adjustment term only and no claim is made about executable P&L.
